description:
Lists the books in the reader's ReadingRate library with their status (read, reading, want to read, stopped), rating, start and finish dates, and the reader's own reflection, newest activity first.

Use when the user asks what they have read or finished, what is on their want-to-read list, how they rated a book, or which of a set of books they have already read.

Filter with status. Set include_sessions to add the reading sessions logged for each book.

include_sessions.description: Include the reading sessions logged for each book (default false)

status.description: Only books with this status. Omit for all.

name: get_reading_history

filter.description: The filters applied: status, limit, include_sessions

history.description: Books in the reader's library, newest activity first

book.description: Book info: id, slug, title, authors, difficulty_score, literary_regard, word_count, genres, cover_url

current_page.description: For a copy with a roman-numbered introduction, counted from page i: show page_label

front_matter_pages.description: The copy's roman-numbered pages (an introduction numbered i–lx is 60); only when set

page_label.description: current_page as the book prints it, e.g. "liv" or "10"; only for a copy with a roman-numbered introduction

progress_percent.description: 0 to 100 over the whole copy, introduction included; null when total_pages is null

sessions.description: Reading sessions, present when include_sessions is true. For a copy with a roman-numbered introduction, pages_start and pages_end count from page i, and pages_start_label and pages_end_label give them as printed

total_pages.description: Printed pages in the reader's own copy (the page count they entered, less any roman introduction, else their edition, else the primary edition); null when unknown or when current_page is past the copy's end

title: Get reading history
